no_adcom_quote.quote: No Advisory Committee meeting was conducted.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the NDA200655 review cycle for fluorodopa F18 (18F-FDOPA). Instead, during the 2016 resubmission review the FDA team consulted two independent Special Government Employees (both MIDAC members) to independently read Study #17 PET images. Historical AC meetings referenced in the review (e.g., July 28, 2000 and an August 11, 2009 Peripheral and Central Nervous System Advisory Committee) predated this NDA cycle and were not convened for this application, so no AdComm influenced this approval.
